description:
The Malaysian Communications and Multimedia Commission (MCMC) and #Huawei celebrated 126 graduates from the Digital Leadership Excellence (DLE) Programme, strengthening digital leadership across government, academia and industry in Malaysia.
 
The national initiative focuses on applied leadership development and exposure to emerging technologies, including 5G, artificial intelligence, cloud computing, big data, green technology and cybersecurity. 
 
Watch and discover how DLE equips leaders to solve real problems and build Malaysia's digital future: https://bit.ly/4dlRtSR #HuaweiNews
title: MCMC and Huawei Expand Digital Leadership in Malaysia
